name: always-on-time
description: Automate the meeting alarms Always On Time rings on your Android phone.

interface.longDescription:
Set up your meeting alarms by telling ChatGPT how you want them to work, in the Always On Time app for Android. Requires the app on your phone, signed in under Settings > Account & sync.

Say "Ring 20 minutes early for my gym sessions," "Ring an hour before my flight on Friday," or "No alarms for my personal calendar." Set alarms for one meeting, every meeting in a recurring series or a whole calendar, change alarm and snooze settings, or pause alarms until a set time. You can also ask what rings next and why. Changes are sent to your phone, and each one can be undone for 30 days.

You approve the connection on a consent page. ChatGPT receives meeting titles and times from the calendars your phone watches, 14 days of alarm history and the app's alarm settings. It works only with Always On Time's alarms: your calendar events stay unchanged, and meeting locations, links, notes and attendees stay on your phone.
defaultPrompt: Ring 20 minutes early for my gym sessions.
Ring an hour before my flight on Friday.

positive.description: List the alarms that ring soon
positive.expected_behavior: Lists tomorrow's meetings from the demo account with each alarm's time and how long before the meeting it rings, in the phone's time zone.

positive.description: Explain why a meeting has its alarms
positive.prompt: Why does my design review have the alarms it has?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the design review and explains where its alarms come from (the app default, its calendar, its series or the meeting itself).

positive.description: Change one meeting's alarms and confirm
positive.prompt: Make my next design review ring 15 minutes before it starts as well.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a 15-minute alarm to that one meeting, reports the change ID, confirms the phone applied it, and the meeting then lists the new alarm.

positive.prompt: Pause my alarms until tomorrow at 9am, then show me what's paused.
positive.expected_behavior: Pauses alarms until 9:00 the next morning in the phone's time zone; alarms before then are listed as paused. Saying "resume my alarms" turns them back on (resume_alarms).
Reverses the most recent change made in the conversation and reports that the earlier alarms are back.

negative.description: Creating calendar events is out of scope
negative.prompt: Add a dentist appointment to my calendar for Friday at 3pm.
What's the Zoom link and location for my design review?
Turn off my coworker's alarms for the standup.

review.commerce_description: Always On Time's assistant connection is free and doesn't sell anything.

publication.release_notes: Clearer name and description, and live traffic is no longer linked as an upgrade.
